world.title: U.S. State Secretary Rubio to visit India for energy talks next week; visit to Jamnagar on cards
world.summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio will visit India next week to enhance energy cooperation between the U.S. and India, according to the U.S. Department of State. His itinerary includes a visit to Jamnagar, a key location for energy discussions. Prior to India, Rubio will stop in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, as part of his diplomatic engagements.

world.title: ‘They both want it to end’: Trump denies US halted sharing intel with Ukraine
world.summary: US President Donald Trump denied claims that the United States had ceased intelligence sharing with Ukraine. He stated he is collaborating with both Kyiv and Moscow to bring an end to the Russia-Ukraine conflict. Trump made these remarks to reporters before leaving for a campaign event in Alaska, emphasizing his commitment to resolving the ongoing war.

world.title: Saudi Aramco headquarters hit by missile as Houthi conflict intensifies
world.summary: A ballistic missile struck a Saudi Aramco administrative building in Dhahran, resulting in a limited fire but no reported casualties. This attack occurred amid escalating tensions and increased Houthi strikes, reflecting a resurgence of conflict between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-backed Houthi movement in Yemen. The situation highlights the ongoing instability in the region and its implications for security.

business.title: Stock Market Today: All You Need To Know Before Going Into Trade On October 14
business.summary: GIFT Nifty is down 71.8 points at 22,763, suggesting a weak market opening. Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty 50 are expected to face pressure as trading begins. Key brokerage calls and stock news will influence market sentiment. Investors should prepare for potential volatility and monitor developments closely as the trading day unfolds on October 14.

business.title: Stocks in news: Adani Enterprises, Hyundai Motor India, BHEL, BEL, Groww, Tata Elxsi and RailTel
business.summary: Indian stocks rose over 1.5%, driven by positive investor sentiment following Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman's comments on long-term capital gains tax. Key companies in focus included Adani Enterprises and Hyundai Motor India. Tata Elxsi saw a slight profit dip, but revenue and EBIT improved. Bharat Electronics secured new orders worth Rs 533 crore, boosting its order backlog.

business.title: Rollout of BS-VII in 3 phases from April 2029 to April 2035
business.summary: The Indian government will implement BS-VII emission standards, aligned with Euro 7 norms, in three phases from April 2029 to April 2035. These new regulations aim to establish stricter limits on harmful pollutants, including nitrogen oxides, hydrocarbons, and particulate matter. The phased rollout reflects the government's commitment to improving air quality and reducing environmental impact from vehicular emissions.

technology.title: Apple Stock Hits All-Time Highs - And There Could Be Good News About iPhone Duo
technology.summary: Apple Inc's stock (NASDAQ: AAPL) reached all-time highs on Tuesday, coinciding with the announcement of new home products. This follows recent negative reports regarding the iPhone 18, but there are indications of potential positive developments for the smartphone. The stock is currently exhibiting an upward trend, raising questions about the future trajectory of AAPL shares.

technology.title: 'Just Dance' Costume Designer Breaks Down Commitment to Not Using AI
technology.summary: Ubisoft's "Just Dance: Decades of Hits," launched on Tuesday, emphasizes a commitment to traditional creativity by not utilizing AI in character and costume design. As AI becomes more prevalent in creative fields, the game's team maintains a hands-on approach, prioritizing human artistry over automated processes. This decision highlights a dedication to preserving the authenticity of the game's visual elements.

technology.title: No Man’s Sky Headlines Apple’s New Wave of iPhone and iPad Games
technology.summary: Apple announced a new lineup of indie games for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPad, including "No Man’s Sky," "Sifu," "Vampire Crawler," and "Dome Keeper." This release aims to enhance the gaming experience on the latest devices, despite previous announcements lacking significant gaming updates. The new titles are now available on the App Store for mobile gamers.

sports.title: WTC 2025-27 points table: South Africa crash out of top two after Durban defeat; where does India stand?
sports.summary: South Africa has fallen to third place in the ICC World Test Championship (WTC) 2025-27 standings after a 214-run defeat to Australia in the first Test at Durban. This loss has impacted their position, allowing Australia to strengthen their lead. The current rankings reflect the ongoing competition as teams vie for a spot in the WTC final.

sports.title: ADSW vs HHW Today Match Prediction and Betting Tips, Odds and Live Score
sports.summary: Adelaide Strikers Women (ADSW) will face Hobart Hurricanes Women (HHW) in the 9th match of the T20 Spring Challenge 2026 on October 14. The match is scheduled to start at 13:30 IST at Bankstown Oval, Sydney. Predictions, betting tips, and live scores will be available for fans following the game.

sports.title: Manchester United’s Martinez blasts board’s lack of investment
sports.summary: Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez criticized the club's board for insufficient investment following a 2-0 defeat to Atletico Madrid in the Champions League. This loss marked United's fifth consecutive game without a win across all competitions. Martinez's comments reflect growing frustration among players regarding the team's performance and the lack of support from the management in strengthening the squad.

health.title: ECG Data from Sleep Studies Predict Long-Term Cardiac Risk
health.summary: Artificial intelligence analyzing ECG data from overnight sleep studies can predict long-term risks of heart failure and death. The model processes single-lead heart monitor data, allowing for early identification of individuals at risk. This advancement in cardiac risk prediction may enhance preventative measures and improve patient outcomes by enabling timely interventions based on the identified risks.

health.title: NIMS Doctors Urge Early Detection Of Blood Clots To Prevent Stroke, Heart Attack
health.summary: Doctors at Nizam’s Institute of Medical Sciences (NIMS) emphasize the importance of early detection of blood clots, known as thrombosis, to prevent serious health issues like stroke, heart attack, and pulmonary embolism. They stress recognizing warning signs promptly to avoid complications. Awareness and timely intervention are crucial in managing the risks associated with blood clot formation in blood vessels.

health.title: AI searches for a better, lightweight network to predict epileptic seizures
health.summary: Researchers from Hefei University of Technology and the University of Science and Technology of China have developed a neural architecture search framework for predicting epileptic seizures using EEG data. Their study, titled "A Hybrid Convolutional, Mamba and Spiking Neural Network Architecture Search for Seizure Prediction," was published in the journal Cyborg and Bionic Systems on September 30, 2026.

science.title: Advances in science in 2026 humanity enters a new era of discovery
science.summary: The year 2026 marks a pivotal moment in scientific advancement, highlighting breakthroughs in various fields. Key areas of progress include artificial intelligence, quantum computing, genetic engineering, cancer treatment, neuroscience, and space exploration. These developments are reshaping humanity's understanding of science and technology, paving the way for innovative solutions and enhanced capabilities that could significantly impact future generations.

science.title: Scientists discover ‘hidden materials’ that may lead to better batteries and solar fuels
science.summary: An international research team has discovered a new class of "hidden materials" by observing rapid molecular changes during decomposition under heat. This breakthrough, published in Nature Communications, could enhance the development of advanced batteries and solar fuels. The findings may lead to improved energy storage solutions and more efficient renewable energy technologies, potentially transforming energy systems globally.

entertainment.title: 'Hanuman Ansh' box office collection day 68: Vishal Chaturvedi’s film earns Rs 1.30 cr; worldwide gross reaches Rs 438.40 cr; devotional drama maintains blockbuster verdict
entertainment.summary: Vishal Chaturvedi’s film 'Hanuman Ansh' earned Rs 1.30 crore net in India on Day 68, reflecting a 4% increase from the previous day's collection of Rs 1.25 crore. The worldwide gross for the devotional drama has reached Rs 438.40 crore, maintaining its status as a blockbuster. The film continues to perform well at the box office.
